description: This file contains the server-side code for the EditTheory page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It manages page load behavior, navigation via button clicks, and dynamic population of course selection dropdown lists based on semester selection.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: A partial class for the ASP.NET WebForms page handling course editing, navigation, and dropdown list management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page; currently performs no actions on load.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Updates session data with selected course text.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester from predefined lists.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Repopulates the course dropdown when the semester selection changes.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for handling course dropdown selection changes (currently empty).
